fronts.name: descriptor capability gate
fronts.finding: The prior capability gate was insufficient for descriptor-relative name custody because it did not require stat(..., dir_fd=..., follow_symlinks=False). The gate and its regression source now require both stat capabilities.

fronts.name: held-directory descriptor custody
fronts.finding: A held O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW root descriptor now anchors bounded descriptor-relative enumeration/open/stat source work. This materially strengthens root custody after the descriptor is acquired, but does not prove universal filesystem atomicity, candidate swap-and-restore immunity, identity-reuse immunity, or canonical v10 owner integration.
